plan.title: Explore workspace structure and existing artifacts
plan.description: List all files/directories in data/, examine existing yaml configs, existing split files (train_split.json, val_split.json), and any pre-trained models. Check what labels directories exist (labels_yolov8x_1280, labels_sc, etc.). Understand what has already been done.
plan.success_criteria: Complete inventory of workspace contents, understanding of existing configs and splits

plan.title: Deep dive: data, splits, products, existing models, and environment
plan.hypothesis: Understanding all available resources at once will let us skip unnecessary setup steps
plan.description: Combined exploration: (1) Load annotations.json - count per-category annotations, image dimensions, avg annotations per image. (2) Check train_split.json/val_split.json sizes and split ratio. (3) Explore data/products/ directory - count reference images per product, cross-reference with categories. (4) Search ENTIRE workspace recursively for .pt weight files (trained models). (5) Check GPU availability, CUDA version, installed packages (ultralytics, torch, timm, pycocotools versions). (6) Read all YAML config files fully. (7) Check data/metadata.json.
plan.success_criteria: Complete picture of all available resources, especially whether pre-trained models exist

plan.title: Build evaluation pipeline and create 90/10 train/val split
plan.hypothesis: A reliable evaluation function is essential before any experiments
plan.description: Write utils.py with: (1) Create 90/10 stratified train/val split with seed=42 (save as train_split.json and val_split.json in COCO format). (2) COCO evaluation function computing detection_mAP@0.5 (all cats mapped to one class) and classification_mAP@0.5 (original categories), returning val_score = 0.7*det + 0.3*cls using pycocotools COCOeval. (3) Helper to convert YOLO predictions to COCO format. (4) Also create YOLO-format label directories for train/val splits. Verify everything works with a dummy prediction.
plan.success_criteria: Split created with ~223 train / ~25 val images. Evaluation function runs without errors on dummy predictions.

plan.title: Train YOLOv8x multiclass (nc=356) baseline at imgsz=1280
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8x with 356 classes at 1280 resolution provides a baseline for both detection and classification
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x with nc=356 at imgsz=1280 for 100 epochs on the train split. Use data_multiclass.yaml (adjusted for our split). Evaluate on val split with our evaluation function. Record detection_mAP, classification_mAP, and val_score.
plan.success_criteria: Training completes. val_score > 0.15 as initial baseline.

plan.title: Train YOLOv8x single-class detector (nc=1) at imgsz=1280
plan.hypothesis: A single-class detector achieves higher detection mAP since it doesn't need to distinguish 356 classes, and detection is weighted 70%
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x with nc=1 at imgsz=1280 for 100 epochs using data_single_class.yaml (adjusted for our split). Evaluate detection_mAP@0.5 on val split. Compare against nc=356 model's detection performance.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP@0.5 for nc=1 model is higher than nc=356 model's detection_mAP.

plan.title: DINOv2 embedding gallery + kNN classification on GT boxes
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2 embeddings from reference product images and training crops can classify detected crops better than YOLO's built-in classification for 356 categories
plan.description: Build DINOv2-base embedding gallery from: (1) reference product images in data/products/, (2) training annotation crops. For each category, store mean embedding. Implement kNN classification (k=5, cosine distance). Test standalone classification accuracy on GT boxes from val set to establish classification ceiling.
plan.success_criteria: Classification accuracy on GT boxes > 50%. classification_mAP on GT boxes measurable.

plan.title: Two-stage pipeline: nc=1 YOLO + DINOv2 classification
plan.hypothesis: Combining best detector (nc=1) with DINOv2 classification achieves higher val_score than nc=356 YOLO alone
plan.description: Use nc=1 YOLO detections, crop each detection from full-res image, embed with DINOv2-base, classify via kNN against gallery. Compute full val_score = 0.7*det_mAP + 0.3*cls_mAP. Compare against nc=356 YOLO end-to-end.
plan.success_criteria: val_score of two-stage pipeline > val_score of nc=356 YOLO baseline.

plan.title: NMS tuning + confidence threshold + max_det optimization
plan.hypothesis: With ~91 annotations per image on average, default NMS settings may be suboptimal for dense shelves
plan.description: Sweep NMS IoU threshold (0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7), confidence threshold (0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25), and max_det (100, 200, 300, 500) on val split using best detector. Record detection_mAP and val_score for each combination.
plan.success_criteria: Find settings that improve detection_mAP by at least 0.5 points over defaults.

plan.title: SAHI-style tiled inference for small product detection
plan.hypothesis: Tiled inference on high-res images catches small products missed by single-pass inference
plan.description: Implement SAHI-style sliced inference: split each image into overlapping tiles (e.g., 1280x1280 with stride 960), run detector on each tile + full image, merge with WBF or NMS. Test on val split. Measure detection_mAP improvement.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP improves by at least 1 point over single-pass inference.

plan.title: DINOv2 classification tuning: k, temperature, gallery composition
plan.hypothesis: Tuning kNN hyperparameters and gallery composition improves classification accuracy
plan.description: Sweep k (1,3,5,7,11), temperature scaling, gallery variants (reference only, crops only, both, weighted). Also try DINOv2-large if it fits in memory. Measure classification_mAP for each on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Find configuration that improves classification_mAP by at least 1 point.

plan.title: Ensemble and TTA for detection improvement
plan.hypothesis: Multi-scale inference and model ensembling can improve detection by 1-2 points
plan.description: Try: (1) TTA with augment=True, (2) multi-scale inference at 1280+1920 fused with WBF, (3) ensemble nc=1 and nc=356 detectors with WBF. Measure detection_mAP improvements.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP improves by at least 1 point over best single-model inference.

plan.title: Assemble best pipeline and optimize end-to-end
plan.hypothesis: Combining all best techniques achieves the highest val_score
plan.description: Assemble the full pipeline with best detector config, best tiling, best classification method, best NMS settings. Run end-to-end on val split. Measure total inference time and model sizes. Fine-tune any remaining parameters.
plan.success_criteria: Highest val_score achieved. Inference time < 300s. Model weights < 420MB.

plan.title: Build submission run.py and package
plan.description: Write run.py implementing the best pipeline. Ensure only allowed imports (pathlib not os, json not yaml). Test with simulated sandbox constraints. Verify weights < 420MB, inference < 300s. Package into submission.zip.
plan.hypothesis: The submission pipeline runs correctly within all constraints
plan.success_criteria: run.py executes end-to-end, produces valid COCO predictions, within time and size limits.

plan.title: End-to-end submission verification
plan.hypothesis: The submission pipeline runs correctly within all constraints
plan.description: Run complete pipeline end-to-end on val images, timing each component. Verify output format matches COCO predictions. Verify total time < 300s, weights < 420MB. Run 3 times for consistency.
plan.success_criteria: Consistent val_score across runs. All constraints met.
